# PlanProof

> Engineering plans are hypotheses. PlanProof tests them before agents build them.
> The model proposes; deterministic code authorizes.

PlanProof is a pre-flight verification system for AI-generated software engineering plans. It binds candidate implementation plans to immutable repository snapshots, extracts testable proof obligations, gathers code-backed evidence using bounded deterministic tools, escalates authority gaps to humans, and computes deterministic Plan Gates before code execution begins.

## Core Capabilities
- Pre-flight plan verification against real Git commit snapshots.
- Cryptographically verified server-issued evidence authority (SHA-256 hashes, file line ranges).
- Deterministic repository tools (Python stdlib `ast.parse`, lightweight TS/JS symbol indexing, bounded lexical search).
- Single bounded orchestrator with durable MongoDB state and async Redis/Dramatiq worker execution.
- Human-in-the-loop (HITL) authority boundaries (`HUMAN_REQUIRED` pause & resumption).
- Dual model provider redundancy (OpenRouter primary with automatic AIMLAPI fallback).
- 27-case versioned evaluation harness with explicit regression gating.

## Key Architectural Principles
- **The model proposes; deterministic code authorizes**: Models extract structured proof obligations; deterministic code validates schemas, executes snapshot-scoped repository tools, evaluates evidence sufficiency, mints evidence IDs, and computes final gate status.
- **Single Orchestrator vs. Multi-Agent Swarms**: A single bounded orchestrator keeps the causal workflow straightforward to audit; durable state lives in MongoDB and Redis/Dramatiq transports/resumes work.
- **Indexed Symbols + Exact Source Evidence vs. Premature Vector RAG**: Code verification prioritizes exact syntactic symbol definitions, paths, source ranges, and SHA-256 content hashes rather than fuzzy semantic retrieval.
